data.one_liner: Circular progress and seek bar package for Flutter supporting animations, dashes, and gradients.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable circular seek bar widget that supports progress tracking, inner and outer thumbs, start and sweep angles, gradients, dashed paths, touch interaction, and entry animations.
use_when: You need a circular slider or progress indicator with interactive touch controls.
You require customizable gradients, stroke caps, and dash patterns on a circular arc.
avoid_when: You only need standard linear progress bars.
You require complex chart types like pie or bar charts.
strengths: Highly customizable with gradients, dashes, custom start/sweep angles, and thumbs.
Supports interactive touch input and animation curves out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited to circular seek/progress bar use cases.
Not documented for non-UI data manipulation.
data.minimal_example:
CircularSeekBar(
  width: double.infinity,
  height: 250,
  progress: 50,
  barWidth: 8,
  startAngle: 90,
  sweepAngle: 360,
  animation: true,
)
